title: ChromaSave SmartPurge Configuration
description: Post-processing optimization for early filament cutting and dynamic purge reduction.

len.title: Remaining Length - Cutter to Nozzle (mm)
len.description: Filament length between the cutter blade and the nozzle tip (e.g., 64.857 mm for ChromaHead, ~38.25 mm for Bambu Lab A1).

sm.title: Safety Margin (mm)
sm.description: Safety buffer subtracted from the remaining length to prevent premature color transitions on the model.

min_saving.title: Minimum Saving Threshold (mm)
min_saving.description: Minimum filament saving required to execute an early-cut. Savings below this value are omitted to avoid unnecessary travel moves.

skip_purge.title: Skip Purge Threshold (mm)
skip_purge.description: Minimum residual purge length in the bucket/chute. Values below this threshold will skip the dynamic purge macro.

purge_target.title: Purge Target Mode
purge_target.description: Hybrid discounts the prime/wipe tower volume from the total purge required. Bucket Only sends all required purge to the waste chute/bucket.

sre.title: Search Retractions for Cut Relocation
sre.description: Prioritize existing retraction moves and Z-hops within the tolerance window to hide the toolchange seam.

rem.title: Retraction Search Margin (mm)
rem.description: Tolerance window before the target length to lock onto a retraction command.

aipc.title: Avoid In-Piece Cut on Aesthetic Zones
aipc.description: Restrict early-cuts exclusively to the active Safety Zones defined below.

SAFETY_ZONES.title: Allowed Safety Zones for Early-Cut
SAFETY_ZONES.description: Enable the print features where ChromaSave is allowed to execute an early filament cut.
